subject.title: feat: trace Claude Code CLI model calls

question: Should the public `model.call` diagnostic remain an individual upstream-request contract, or intentionally expand to include opaque aggregate Claude CLI turns?
rationale: Claude CLI does not expose request-level boundaries, IDs, retries, payloads, or TTFB, so choosing the same event name changes the public telemetry unit rather than merely adding instrumentation.

options.title: Preserve request semantics
options.body: Keep aggregate Claude CLI telemetry under harness/run or a new typed CLI-turn event, reserving `model.call` for observable request boundaries.

options.title: Expand the model-call contract
options.body: Intentionally redefine `model.call` to include aggregate turns and update event documentation, exporters, metrics, dashboards, and compatibility tests for the mixed observation units.

recommendation.title: Preserve request semantics
recommendation.body: Keep aggregate Claude CLI telemetry under harness/run or a new typed CLI-turn event, reserving `model.call` for observable request boundaries.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision changes the diagnostics event and exporter contract whose foundation is most closely connected to Vincent Koc's merged feature history.
